name: grokpair
description: Delegate research, reviews, code, documents or media to a detached Grok Build collaborator while your agent keeps working. Requires your own Grok Build installation and authentication.

interface.shortDescription: A Grok Build collaborator working beside your agent.
interface.longDescription: Delegate a bounded piece of work to Grok Build while your agent continues: research, a review, an alternative implementation in a native worktree, a document or media. Read the full result, ask for corrections in the same conversation and decide what to use. Requires Node.js and your own installed, authenticated Grok Build. Installation starts no collaborator; your agent remains responsible for integration and publication.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok to review this change read-only while I keep working, then read its findings.
Have Grok research this question with sources; wait for its result and check the key claims.
Give Grok a worktree to draft an alternative implementation, then inspect its diff.
